handbookNote: Rhode Island General Laws Chapter 42-30.1 (Uniform Law on Notarial Acts) -- batch 2 depth expansion. Batch 1 (65 questions) covered the chapter's core commissioning, notarial-act, remote-notarization, stamp/fee, and discipline provisions at a first pass; batch 2 adds ~147 new, non-duplicate questions grounded in previously-untapped statutory ground within the same chapter: the full 42-30.1-2 definitions list, the 4(b)/4(c) determination requirements, remaining subsections of 42-30.1-6/7 (identification and refusal), the prima-facie-vs-conclusive evidentiary distinctions across 42-30.1-9 through -12, the 42-30.1-12.1/-12.2 remote-notarization certificate and recordkeeping mechanics, 42-30.1-13/14/17 stamp and technology-notification detail, the remaining 42-30.1-15 qualification/oath subsections plus RI Dept. of State administrative-practice facts (processing time, no-bond fact), the 42-30.1-18 advertising/immigration-related prohibitions, and the 42-30.1-16/19/21/22/23/24 discipline, validity-doctrine, and transition provisions -- plus scenario/application variants of already-covered rules using new fact patterns. 80% pass threshold on the Secretary of State's self-graded online Notary Knowledge Assessment; price matches this project's established Notary tier ($9.99), not a placeholder.
